  "summary": "This PR adds `btck_chainstate_manager_set_clock_time` and `ChainstateManager::Now()` to allow callers to inject and override current clock time on a per-chainstate-manager basis. It routes time-sensitive validation checks (such as the block header future-time check and the IBD tip-age check) through this instance-scoped method instead of `NodeClock::now()`. It also refactors mempool time tracking to use `NodeClock::time_point` and moves `now()` symbols to a file omitted from `libbitcoinkernel` to catch accidental nondeterministic clock usage at link time.",

result.summary: This PR adds `btck_chainstate_manager_set_clock_time` and `ChainstateManager::Now()` to allow callers to inject and override current clock time on a per-chainstate-manager basis. It routes time-sensitive validation checks (such as the block header future-time check and the IBD tip-age check) through this instance-scoped method instead of `NodeClock::now()`. It also refactors mempool time tracking to use `NodeClock::time_point` and moves `now()` symbols to a file omitted from `libbitcoinkernel` to catch accidental nondeterministic clock usage at link time.
result.problem: Validation logic in `libbitcoinkernel` directly queries system time via global clock functions, forcing external applications and tests to rely on global mock time to run deterministically. Global clock manipulation prevents concurrent test instances from having independent clocks and introduces intermittent test races across second boundaries, such as in `chainstatemanager_ibd_exit_after_loading_blocks`.
evidence: PR description: provides an instance-scoped alternative to PR #35496 (`btck_set_mock_time`) allowing 'kernel applications run validation code deterministically without depending on the system clock' and allowing concurrent instances without global state cleanup.

Commit f398f93593: fixes an intermittent test race where `chainstatemanager_ibd_exit_after_loading_blocks` would spuriously fail if a second boundary was crossed between setting up tip time and calling `UpdateIBDStatus()`.
result.scope_notes: The PR combines the instance-scoped clock API with a broader mempool time-type refactor (`MempoolTime`) and a build system change that separates `now()` into `time_nondet.cpp` to prevent linking nondeterministic clock calls into `libbitcoinkernel`.
result.card: This pull request adds an instance-scoped clock override API (`btck_chainstate_manager_set_clock_time`) to ChainstateManager and bitcoinkernel, routing validation time checks through `ChainstateManager::Now()`. This solves the problem of validation code depending directly on the host system clock or process-global mock time, which prevented kernel consumers from running deterministic multi-instance validation and caused race conditions across second boundaries in tests. In addition to fixing an intermittent IBD unit test failure, it enforces clock determinism by preventing `libbitcoinkernel` from linking directly against `NodeClock::now()`. No prerequisites are required.
